tagline.en_US:
A fast reverse proxy to help you expose a local server behind a NAT or firewall to your client, remote access all your self-hosted server/self-hosted server apps.

Use OpenIoTHub to scan the following QR code add a gateway,then add host,add self-hosted server/self-hosted server host's web page port,finally, enjoy remote control

description.en_US: gateway-go is a reverse proxy that runs continuously on a local network to receive remote access requests for OpenIoTHub. It allows services and servers situated behind a NAT or firewall to be reached from outside the local environment. Users can connect to local network ports and services remotely through the OpenIoTHub client application.

tips: Scan the displayed QR code using the OpenIoTHub application to pair and add the gateway.
